thread:
viv: FYI when I open a per-route analytics view with model panels expanded the page blocks on load. cold p95 ~2s.
sasha: saw that too. we do route-summary then loop N x /model/metrics. client waits for all responses before rendering main chart.
ben: backend idea: new combined endpoint so the client gets route + model slices in one payload. fewer RTTs.
viv: product thing: aggregated fetch will use more telemetry. we need to be explicit about quotas and costs.
kai: suggestion: saved-query gets field prefetch: on|off|auto. auto = server picks based on org quota signals.
sasha: API sketch: GET /api/console/views/{id}?prefetch=models&model_sample=0.2&cache_ttl=20. Response includes meta string line: "prefetch_status:served_full|sampled|downgraded". client shows a banner when not full.
ben: ops asks for header X-Prefetch-Status: downgraded when fallback happened, and meter tag console.view.telemetry with view_id+org_id. emit event on downgrade.
billing-bot: confirm we'll need meter tags: console.view.telemetry, telemetry.downgraded, telemetry.cache_hit. include view_id and org_id in tags. cache hits must still emit a lightweight billing ping.
viv: UX microcopy draft: "Show per-model telemetry (may increase telemetry usage)." Tooltip: "We may sample or fall back to route-level metrics if your org quota is constrained." show small badge: "telemetry: sampled" when applicable.
kai: rollout plan: behind feature flag -> combined endpoint + meta headers -> client toggle persisted on saved views -> beta opt-ins -> default off GA. session caching for quick navigations.
sasha: perf test on staging: combined endpoint median 370ms (baseline 2.0s), p95 900ms (baseline 3.1s). run id: pref-ch-2026-03-24.
ben: I'll prototype server downgrade logic and X-Prefetch-Status header in staging.
kai: I'll own saved-query schema and client UI. viv will own umbrella ticket and acceptance criteria.
billing-bot: will add billing docs and meter contract.
deploy-bot: ci: console/prefetch-integration passed (commit abc123).
viv: great. let's keep defaults conservative, surface quota/cost clearly, and iterate after beta metrics. :thumbsup:
end of thread
